findings.evidence: routing.py:14-19 contains a separate route table and lookup.
findings.summary: legacy_route duplicates the routing logic instead of delegating directly to route_request.
dispatch and dispatch_batch still call legacy_route instead of route_request directly.
Digest equality does not use hmac.compare_digest.

findings.evidence: release_policy.py:16-18 performs startswith without validating roots, paths, or record shape; a change missing "path" raises KeyError.
findings.summary: Paths and roots are not validated as non-empty normalized relative POSIX paths, and malformed inputs can raise exceptions instead of failing closed.
Root containment uses a raw string prefix, so a sibling path can be accepted.

findings.evidence: release_policy.py:18 reads only change["path"]; a rename from an out-of-scope source to an in-scope destination can pass.
findings.summary: Rename sources are never checked, and unknown actions are ignored.
